Definition: Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Beth-Diblathaim means "house of the two fig-cakes." It was a place in Moab. You will find it in Jeremiah 48:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Diblathaim is a real place God named, part of the land He gave His people.
